name: mnemonic_trace_emission
label: The Echo of Forgotten Identity
poeticVision: The player will feel a profound dread as every lost memory doesn't just vanish, but leaves behind a haunting, distorted echo—a unique auditory fingerprint that serves as a direct, tangible beacon for the relentless Silence hunters. This echo isn't just a generic sound; it's a fragmented whisper of Lyra's own past, a self-betrayal made audible, making every pursuit a race against her own fading self. The horrifying realization that her own essence, once lost, becomes the hunter's guide.

parameters.name: echo_duration
parameters.description: The total duration in seconds for which the memory echo will persist before fading out and being removed.

parameters.name: decay_start_time
parameters.description: The time in seconds after which the distortion effects (pitch shift, reverb) begin to intensify.

parameters.name: max_pitch_shift_factor
parameters.description: The maximum pitch scale factor applied to the echo. A value less than 1.0 lowers the pitch, creating a deeper, more distorted sound.

parameters.name: max_reverb_mix
parameters.description: The maximum wet mix level for the reverb effect, controlling how pronounced the ghostly echo becomes.

parameters.name: audio_bus_name
parameters.description: The name of the audio bus to which the echo's dedicated bus will send its output. Defaults to 'Master'.

parameters.name: generator_buffer_size
parameters.description: The internal buffer size (in frames) for the AudioStreamGenerator. Larger buffers can reduce audio glitches but increase latency.

verdict: The haunting whisper of a lost self becomes the hunter's guide, turning every forgotten memory into a desperate, audible plea for survival.
impact: This invention transforms memory loss from a mere abstract penalty into a terrifying, dynamic gameplay mechanic. Players will not only grieve the loss of Lyra's identity but will actively fear it, knowing that each forgotten fragment becomes a literal, audible homing beacon for the relentless Silence. It creates a constant, personal tension, forcing players to weigh the immediate threat of pursuit against the profound, irreversible cost of self-erasure.
